prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a highly polished high fidelity website design presentation for Chilean pet care brand "Milo y sus amigos". Image 1 is a reference logo only: use the actual provided small logo in header, preserve its white poodle, turquoise circle, black paws and script personality; do not redesign brand. This is a visual proposal, not a coded website. Landscape design board 1800x1200 or larger. Cream background, left 72% large flat desktop homepage, right 25% separate tall mobile homepage at readable scale, no computer hardware, no perspective. Label small at top "01 / INICIO · PROPUESTA VISUAL".
Art direction: premium yet warm neighborhood pet care, contemporary editorial rounded sans typography, dark forest green #163C36 headings, turquoise #10ACB5 accents from logo, cream #FAF8F1, mint #E9F5EF and soft peach #F7E1CE. Generous but efficiently used space. Subtle paw line motifs only. Beautiful photorealistic white groomed poodle with turquoise neckerchief next to calm cat, light mint studio photo, authentic natural proportions. Photos are illustrative.
DESKTOP: compact header logo at left; nav "Tienda", "Peluquería", "Veterinaria", "Nosotros"; cart icon and dark button "Agendar hora". Hero split: left small eyebrow "PELUQUERÍA · VETERINARIA · PETSHOP", large headline "Su bienestar, nuestra mejor amistad.", short support "Cuidado, salud y todo para tu mascota en un mismo lugar." Right dog and cat photograph in organic rounded frame. Below copy clearly visible THREE compact action buttons "Comprar productos", "Agendar peluquería", "Agendar veterinaria", equal visual clarity, first dark forest second turquoise third white border. Below hero 3 service cards with small real photos: grooming poodle, vet checking dog, pet food and toys. Card titles "Peluquería", "Veterinaria", "Petshop", brief line, clear arrow action. Below compact strip "Los favoritos de tu mejor amigo" with three attractive unbranded product cards, no invented reviews, no fake discounts, no numeric ratings. Footer hint "Ven a conocernos" and "Cómo llegar". Avoid huge empty areas, carousels, floating clutter.
MOBILE: narrow 390px-style composition, compact logo/menu/cart header. Headline wraps 3 lines, small cropped dog photo to the right or below without pushing ALL actions out of first screen. Three full-width compact stacked buttons visible near top with exact same 3 actions. Then service cards vertically and start of favorites. Fixed bottom nav "Inicio", "Tienda", "Agendar", "Mi cuenta"; do not cover content. Board bottom caption "Fotografías ilustrativas · Contenido por validar". Crisp Spanish typography, coherent detailed realistic UI, professionally art directed.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create a very polished high fidelity MOBILE user flow design board for Chilean pet care brand "Milo y sus amigos". Landscape 1800x1200 or larger, three equal tall flat mobile web screens each approximately 390x844, no device bezels, no perspective. Cream board background with top title "02 / COMPRAR Y AGENDAR" and subtitles above each column "TIENDA", "PELUQUERÍA", "VETERINARIA". Same visual system: forest green #163C36 text/buttons, turquoise #10ACB5 accent, cream #FAF8F1 surfaces, mint #E9F5EF, subtle peach. Rounded contemporary sans typography, clean practical forms, accurate Spanish readable text. Poodle paw logo-inspired miniature mark and "Milo y sus amigos" brand header. Add board footer clearly "Datos, precios y disponibilidad de ejemplo".
SCREEN ONE Tienda: header small brand cart count 1; title "Todo para tu mejor amigo"; search input "Buscar productos"; pet filter pills "Perros", "Gatos"; category chips "Alimentos", "Higiene", "Accesorios"; 2 column grid four photorealistic unbranded products on soft neutral backgrounds: "Alimento adulto" / "3 kg" / "$18.990", "Juguete mordedor" / "$5.990", "Shampoo suave" / "$8.990", "Arnés ajustable" / "$12.990"; each button "Agregar". Compact lower summary "1 producto · $18.990" and "Ver carrito". bottom nav Inicio Tienda Agendar Mi cuenta.
SCREEN TWO Peluquería: back arrow and title "Agenda peluquería"; progress "Servicio — Horario — Datos"; service selected "Baño + corte"; short includes text "Baño, corte y secado"; fields "Tamaño" with selected "Pequeño" and other size pills; "Tipo de pelo" selected "Largo"; note "El valor depende del tamaño y pelaje."; section "Elige tu horario", horizontal date buttons "Lun 19", "Mar 20", "Mié 21", selected Tuesday; available times 10:00 12:00 15:00 17:00, 12 selected; bottom summary "Baño + corte" / "Valor de ejemplo $25.000"; full width "Continuar"; small text "Revisa el resumen antes de confirmar". Comfortable 48px touch targets.
SCREEN THREE Veterinaria: title "Agenda veterinaria"; same progress step but currently "Datos"; small summary card "Consulta general" / "Mar 20 oct · 12:00" / "Valor de ejemplo $25.000". Fields "Nombre de tu mascota" filled "Luna", "Especie" Perro Gato chips with Perro selected; "Nombre del tutor" blank placeholder; "Teléfono" +56 9; "Correo electrónico"; optional "Motivo de la consulta"; link "Ver condiciones de reserva"; clean checkbox "Acepto las condiciones de reserva"; full width bottom button "Confirmar reserva". Tiny text "Recibirás la confirmación al finalizar". No claims of urgent services or fake live availability beyond sample label. Focus on efficient layout and conversion with no unrelated decorations.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create premium high fidelity RESPONSIVE ADMINISTRATION DASHBOARD design board for Chilean pet care business "Milo y sus amigos". Landscape high resolution 1800x1200 or larger. Top label "03 / ADMINISTRACIÓN". Left 76% flat desktop dashboard, right 21% tall mobile adaptation of the same admin agenda, not a public store; cream surrounding board, no perspective, no monitor/phone hardware. Visual system forest green #163C36, turquoise #10ACB5, off white #FAF8F1, mint #E9F5EF, peach #F7E1CE. Compact modern sans typography, practical dense but readable tables, refined subtle borders. NO silly mascot backgrounds or excessive charts. All numbers fictional: visible board footer "Datos ficticios de demostración".
Desktop sidebar dark forest with small poodle brand mark "Milo y sus amigos", small "Administración"; menu "Resumen", "Agenda" selected, "Pedidos", "Productos", "Clientes y mascotas", "Equipo", "Configuración". Main top header title "Agenda del día" subtitle "Lunes 19 de octubre de 2026"; top right "Nueva cita". Three compact KPI cards "Citas de hoy 12", "Pedidos pendientes 4", "Stock bajo 3". Toolbar segmented "Todas", "Peluquería", "Veterinaria"; day/week toggle, date navigation. Main column calendar DAY with hours 09:00 to 17:00, separate lanes "Peluquería · Equipo A", "Peluquería · Equipo B", "Veterinaria". Several clear appointment cards, avoid impossible overlapping appointments in same lane: Luna 10:00 Baño y corte confirmed, Toby 12:00 Baño confirmed, Nala 10:00 Consulta general pending, Max 15:00 Control confirmed. Turquoise for grooming; soft peach for veterinary; statuses textual "Confirmada", "Pendiente". Right inspector details "Luna" / "Baño y corte" / "10:00–11:30" / "Tutor: Cliente demo" / "Perro · pequeño" / "Confirmada"; actions "Reprogramar", "Marcar llegada". At bottom short table "Pedidos por preparar", rows demo #1042 "Retiro en local" "Pagado" "Preparar", #1041 "Retiro en local" "Pendiente de pago" "Ver pedido". Show small inventory alert "3 productos con stock bajo".
Mobile same private dashboard: top compact Milo / profile, title "Agenda", date "Lun 19 oct"; horizontal tabs "Todas", "Peluquería", "Veterinaria"; vertical compact appointment list organized by hour, badges and pet names, each has tappable arrow. Bottom nav "Agenda", "Pedidos", "Productos", "Más"; floating or pinned "+ Nueva cita" positioned above nav without obstructing content. Crisp excellent whitespace use and scannability. This is a static visual design proposal and must look feasible to implement in Next, Tailwind and Motion.
